scripts.verify:prod-html: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root='dist/bazzium/browser';const walk=(dir)=>fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((entry)=>entry.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(dir,entry.name)):path.join(dir,entry.name));if(!fs.existsSync(root)){console.error('Missing build output:',root);process.exit(1);}const htmlFiles=walk(root).filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.html'));const bad=htmlFiles.filter((file)=>{const source=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');return source.includes('/@vite/client')||source.includes('@vite/client');});if(bad.length){console.error('Found Vite dev client in production HTML:');bad.forEach((file)=>console.error(file));process.exit(1);}console.log('Verified: no Vite HMR client scripts in prerendered HTML.');"
scripts.build:ssg: npm run clean && ng build --configuration production && npm run verify:prod-html
